title: Gate one candidate on real incremental prefill
objective: Measure one candidate across traced prefix_tokens by extend_tokens scenarios while exercising SGLang's real paged-prefix and backend dispatch.
preconditions: A production-evidence context profile with incremental-prefill scenarios
steps: Warm or restore the exact prefix KV without including setup in the timed region
Replay each suffix/extend chunk with real ForwardBatch prefix and sequence metadata
Record selected DSA prefill backend and ragged/paged top-k transform for every scenario
Compare baseline and candidate with balanced pairing in eager/graph modes actually used by production
Confirm the same scenarios end-to-end without cache contamination between variants

acceptance.pass: No traced prefix/extend scenario regresses and the containing region plus end-to-end target is met.
acceptance.no_win: A stable scenario loses or the leaf gain vanishes at the production boundary.
acceptance.invalid: Prefix=0 full prefill, a dense contiguous cache, or a decode callable is used as a substitute.

stop_rule: Do not implement a fake leaf approximation when the candidate changes dispatch, page-table, or prefix-cache behavior.
origin_evidence: On Blackwell FP8 KV, current SGLang selects flashmla_sparse when total_kv_tokens < total_q_tokens*512 and flashmla_kv otherwise.
